assessed_concepts: Original source task: Discuss one benefit and one limitation of IoT-enabled weather stations providing accurate weather data.
Discuss one benefit and one limitation of combining measurements from many distributed weather stations instead of depending on one station

markscheme.marking_summary: Many locations provide wider geographical coverage and can reveal local differences. However,uneven sensor quality or network failures may make readings inconsistent or unavailable. Calibration and validation are needed before combining data; more sources do not automatically guarantee accuracy.
